[[File:Flowering_Cacti-SWG.jpg|thumb|250px|right|A [[Flowering cactus|Lokkian cactus]]]]
A '''cactus''' (pl. '''cacti''') was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. Varieties included the [[giant cactus]], [[tentacle-cactus]], [[dune-cactus]], and the [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[arool]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]] possessed numerous, continent-sized plateaus that were once covered in [[cacti forests]], though deforestation and mining had shrunk the range of the forests by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
